WHAT: Three new fields added to the updateMemory() accepted fields whitelist in store.ts

WHERE: src/core/store.ts → updateMemory() method

HOW: Fields now pass through:
- superseded_by: string — ID of the memory that replaces this one
- related_to: string[] — IDs of linked memories (shared 3+ tags)
- event_date: string — ISO date of the event/fact in the memory (YYYY-MM-DD)

WHY: The original whitelist only had explicit fields; any new field was silently dropped. Bug was that manager's Rule 3 (tag linking) would increment linkedCount but never actually update related_to.

GOTCHA: If adding new fields to StoredMemory, always check they're in the updateMemory whitelist or they'll silently drop.
